label: 128-vBucket configuration (Magma)
type: the smaller of Magma's two vBucket configurations, with a minimum memory quota of 100 MiB per node - the default for new Magma buckets in Enterprise Edition, and available only in clusters that have fully migrated to Couchbase Server 8.0.
evidence: Magma supports two vBucket configurations: 128 or 1024
It has a minimum memory quota of 100 MiB per node.
Magma buckets with 128 vBuckets are only available in clusters that have fully migrated to Couchbase Server 8.0 or later.
The 128 vBucket configuration is the default for new buckets in Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition.
note: An 8.0 feature that changes the smallest deployable bucket by an order of magnitude (100 MiB against 1 GiB), and the round's clearest example of a REFERENCE fact whose consequences are only visible in procedures: create-bucket.md offers the choice, edit-bucket.md allows changing it, and migrate-bucket.md states two hard constraints - storage-backend migration cannot cross vBucket counts, and migrating to Magma always produces 1024. The id repeats its namespace (`vbucket:vbucket-count-128`); kept as minted, following the existing `index:index` precedent, because 7 relations already resolve to it and a rename would buy nothing.
